_readme: Explicit guide mapping. One entry per playlist channel, in playlist order. 'id' is the playlist tvg-id (case-sensitive) and becomes the <channel id> in the published guide. 'source' names one of the two allowed feeds (UK1, DK1); 'source_id' is that feed's exact channel id. No fuzzy matching, no fallbacks. Production builds refuse any entry whose status is not 'verified'. To approve a provisional entry, confirm the schedule against an independent listing for the exact stream/region, then set status to 'verified' and record the evidence.
